title: PXAPI business intent set v1
description: The versioned, segmented set of search intents and queries derived from the business context for one Analysis Run (Confluence 39846055 §7); it steers the targeted pass. Every intent belongs to exactly one segment, traces back to at least one business-context fact and carries at least one query; a set without intents is not a set. Every query is language-scoped and states explicitly whether it is a brand query; country scope is optional and its absence means the query is not country-scoped. Which queries were executed and what they returned is not part of this contract.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this intent set belongs to.

generated_at.description: Required. When the intent set was generated.

set_version.description: Required. The version of this intent set as the producer names it; a regenerated set for the same run carries a new version so that targeted evidence can be tied to the set it was collected for.

business_context_ref.description: Required. The business-context artifact the set was derived from.

intents.description: Required. The segmented intents of the set, each with its queries. An empty array is rejected: a set without intents cannot steer the targeted pass, and a run for which no intent could be derived expresses that through its business context and run state, never through an empty set.

intent_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this intent; targeted evidence and diagnosis claims reference it.

segment.description: Required. The segment the intent belongs to: a purchase or contact intent (TRANSACTIONAL), a problem the business solves (PROBLEM_NEED), a check of the business's trustworthiness (TRUST_VALIDATION), a general information need (INFORMATIONAL), a query naming the business (BRAND), a query not naming it (NON_BRAND) or a query bound to the business's location or region (LOCAL_REGIONAL).

derived_from.description: Required. The fact_ids of the business-context facts the intent is derived from. An empty array is rejected: an intent that traces back to no fact has no evidenced basis and is not part of a set.

queries.description: Required. The concrete queries that express the intent in the targeted pass. An empty array is rejected: an intent without queries cannot be executed.

query_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this query; targeted measurement records reference it as their subject.

text.description: Required. The query text exactly as it is to be issued, on a single line.

language.description: Required. The two-letter lowercase language code the query is written in.

country.description: Optional. The two-letter uppercase country code the query is scoped to. Absent means the query is not country-scoped; an unknown country is not representable in v1.

brand_flag.description: Required. Whether the query names the business or its brand (true) or is a non-brand query (false). Stated explicitly on every query so that brand and non-brand visibility are never inferred from the query text.
